about: Varennes is a city on Montreal’s South Shore in Montérégie, Quebec, on the St. Lawrence River east of Boucherville. A historic riverside core sits beside suburban neighbourhoods and industrial land toward the Contrecoeur corridor. It balances heritage streets with commuting links into Greater Montreal. About 21,000 people live in Varennes.
